name: Window Nativizer
description: Brings native GNOME ergonomics and appearance to non-native windows. Seamlessly adds Adwaita-spec rounded corners, GPU-baked shadows, and a 12px GTK-aligned resize band — only where absent. Native libadwaita, libhandy, and Qt-Adwaita apps are detected by reading /proc/<pid>/maps and untouched. Nothing is sent anywhere; the only thing stored is the rule you set.
